about: Parts registry for cultivation characters, round 4 (2026-10-31-cultivation-parts-3, from his note on cult-parts-look-2; round 3 was from cult-parts-look-1). A character is a mix of keys: {gender, build, skin, height, bust, direction, outfit}. Every key resolves here; garments.js runs each piece's recipe against the posed body, so any mix is a parameter change, not a redraw. Cards: council/parts/<piece>.md. Keys follow the passport look spec in council/callsheets/calrunia-creator.md (cr-one-look, cr-first-menu).

m.source: Quaternius Universal Base Characters (Source kit, bought 2026-10-25), Regular_Male_FullBody, CC0

f.source: Quaternius Universal Base Characters (Source kit, bought 2026-10-25), Regular_Female_FullBody, CC0

hemUnit: hem is the hem height above the sole as a fraction of stature

height.unit: m, crown to sole, uniform scale

forearm.unit: girth factor about the elbow-to-wrist line: ramps in from ramp[3] (just above the elbow) to ramp[0], full to ramp[1], back to 1 at ramp[2] (the wrist); a parts default, not a player slider yet

shoulder.unit: girth factor on upper-arm skin about the shoulder-to-elbow line, full from the cap to `full` of the way to the elbow, back to 1 at `out`; the cap above the joint is lowered by `lower` metres; a parts default, not a player slider yet

bust.unit: 1 = the body as bought; breast volume scaled forward by the value and across by its square root

wrap.unit: shells round 3, his note on cult-dir-b-look-3: the women's cross collar as a function of cup size. Each V edge passes over the inner slope of its breast at the apex line, open + openPerCup (cup - 1) of the apex's distance from the midline; the wrap crosses crossBelow + crossPerCup (cup - 1) m under the apex line (k-scaled) Fix 4 (his B on cult-shells-look-5: "the V for the femme to cross higher"): the wrap crosses 2 cm under the apex line at cup 1.0, not 7.5 cm.

bust.bulgeUnit: fix 4 (his note: the bust looks robotic, not elastic, not pushed together when robed): a point drawn toward the midline by the cleavage also swells forward by bulge times the way it moved; press adds to the cleavage strength when the figure wears a robe (mix.outfit)

A1.name: sect uniform: indigo robe under a white gauze outer

B2.name: light travel robe with gourd, no cape

C1.name: ceremonial white and gold over black: knee-length white robe with the widest sleeves and cloud edges in gold, black collar, black ribbon sash, black wide trousers, fly-whisk, gold leaf crown

shell.about: his ruling 2026-11-02: clothing is a rigid shell skinned to the body; stretches at the joints; folds, seams and bands painted
